component.name: Mindustry TNG
component.summary: Custom Mindustry client with algorithmic build automation

description.p: A custom Mindustry client based on Foo's client (mindustry-antigrief) v8, extended with algorithmic build automation: optimal mining, core-adjacent processing and unit-building, and turret defense layout.
Initial custom build: dev environment, Flatpak packaging, automation scaffold.
